title: Coordinate expansion of a k-covector: k!·f(u) = Σ_I f(e'_I)·det(u_b(I_c))
statement: Let N', k ∈ ℕ, f a k-covector on ℝ^{N'} (f ∈ Covector (Euclid N') k: a continuous alternating k-linear map (ℝ^{N'})^k → ℝ, ℝ^{N'} = Euclid N') and u = (u_0, …, u_{k−1}) ∈ (ℝ^{N'})^k. Write e'_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1 (i ∈ Fin N') for the standard basis of ℝ^{N'} and z(i) for the i-th coordinate of z ∈ ℝ^{N'}. Then k!·f(u) = Σ_{I : Fin k → Fin N'} f(e'_{I(0)}, …, e'_{I(k−1)})·det(M_I), where the sum runs over all maps I (no monotonicity or injectivity) and M_I is the k×k matrix with entry u_b(I(c)) in row c and column b (Lean: Matrix.of fun c b => u b (I c)).
lean_statement: ∀ (N' k : ℕ) (f : Covector (Euclid N') k) (u : Fin k → Euclid N'), (k.factorial : ℝ) * f u = ∑ I : Fin k → Fin N', f (fun c => EuclideanSpace.single (I c) (1 : ℝ)) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => u b (I c))
